title: Cop Rock
premise_summary: Cop Rock is an American police procedural musical television series created by Steven Bochco and William M. Finkelstein for ABC. It premiered on September 26, 1990, and broadcast eleven episodes before concluding on December 26. It was both a critical and commercial failure.
